name: s012_chain
description: Source grid scored at the Faraday cup: for each case, the beamline chain (Einzel lens, 3 mm object and mass slits, 9 mm ladder hole) at six Einzel voltages scaled with the beam energy. Extraction 15, 17.5 and 20 kV x cathode 5 to 10 kV x target position -6 to +2 mm, caesium supply above the space-charge limit. For the operating point: the analysed 28Si- current, not just the source's.
